mapper.select: SELECT id, subtitle_id, item_type, label, display_order, created_at, updated_at FROM report_item_definitions WHERE subtitle_id = #{subtitleId} ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT rid.id, rid.subtitle_id, rid.item_type, rid.label, rid.display_order, rid.created_at, rid.updated_at FROM report_item_definitions rid JOIN report_item_subtitles rist ON rist.id = rid.subtitle_id JOIN report_item_groups rig ON rig.id = rist.group_id WHERE rig.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_item_definitions (id, subtitle_id, item_type, label, display_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{subtitleId}, #{itemType}, #{label}, #{displayOrder})
